name: MonarchAiFollowUpSuggestions
title: AiFollowUpSuggestions
wrapsNative: ScrollView(.horizontal) of Button with a capsule ButtonStyle
summary: Follow-up questions shown after an assistant reply, as a horizontally scrolling row of chips.
whenToUse: After a reply, to offer the next questions a person is likely to ask.
whenNotToUse: Not to start an empty conversation (use MonarchAiStarterPrompts) and not for filters (use MonarchTag with a selection).
api: init(_ suggestions: [String], label: String? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (String) -> Void)

options.name: suggestions
options.description: Questions the person might ask next, as complete prompts, already localised. Trimmed; blank and repeated ones are left out.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name "Suggested follow-ups".

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Runs with the text of the chosen suggestion.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The chip takes the AI subtle fill and the AI border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Apply disabled(_:), for example while a reply is generated: muted fill, subtle border, disabled text.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no suggestion left after trimming, nothing is drawn.

appearance: Bordered capsules on the surface fill with default text; pressed takes the AI subtle fill and AI border. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web row is one keyboard tab stop with arrow-key movement (a toolbar). iOS has no such pattern: each chip is its own button that VoiceOver, Switch Control and Full Keyboard Access reach in order, and the scroll view follows the focus. Disabling uses the standard disabled modifier instead of a disabled prop.
accessibility: The row is a container named "Suggested follow-ups", replaceable with label.
Each chip is a standard Button named by the full suggestion, even when the visible text is truncated after two lines.
Each chip has a touch target at least 44 points high.
The row scrolls and mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: A long suggestion wraps to two lines inside a chip at most 288 points wide (scaled with Dynamic Type), then truncates.
